notes: CLOCK: block.number here is the SETTLEMENT chain's height (Sepolia, ~12.45 s/block), not this rollup's ~0.17 s blocks. startBlock/endBlock/roundBlocks all count Sepolia blocks. Read the live value with AuctionBids.getBlock(), never from eth_blockNumber.
decayQ is 2^96/2, i.e. q = 0.5 per grid step.
endBlock 0 = open-ended. roundBlocks 15 is ~3.1 min. 100 MONO/round draws ~48k MONO/day, so the 1M funded lasts ~3 weeks.
Funded in the same broadcast as the deploy, so no backlog accrued against an empty contract.
Only roundBlocks and emissionPerRound are changeable, via setRoundParams (admin, next boundary).

MockIndex.role: GenerousAuction.currency — what bids are escrowed in

AuctionBids.role: Probe. getBlock() returns the chain's on-chain block.number — the number every schedule field must be expressed in.
